levels.surface: محمد بن الحسن بن أحمد بن الوليد

notes: Abu Kahmas narrates in the first person (قال: حضرت موت إسماعيل) and the Imam Abu Abdullah appears and acts in the scene (شد لحييه, كتب في حاشية الكفن): the Imam is not added as a link. Ruling needed: whether the scene makes the Imam a source (rule 11, narrated encounter where the Imam acts). The rahmahu Allah blessing is not part of a surface.
